name: Buying Land
overview: Scripture reveals that the ownership of land ultimately belongs to the LORD, who declares that the earth and all its fullness are His (Psalms 24:1; Leviticus 25:23). While God grants His people the privilege to inhabit and cultivate the land—building houses and planting vineyards (Isaiah 65:21)—He reminds them that they are but sojourners and must recognize His sovereign authority over it. The promise of receiving a fruitful land is contingent upon God’s favor (Numbers 14:8), and believers can trust in God’s provision to meet their needs according to His riches in Christ Jesus (Philippians 4:19).
